hypothesis: The Community-1 AHC distance cut at 0.6 collapses identities in the mixed recording; lowering only this cut may preserve distinct speaker centroids while leaving segmentation, embeddings, VBx, post-processing and count hints unchanged.
independentBasis: The retained public chunk embeddings expose the exact input to AHC and the upstream FluidAudio owner documents threshold as the only distance-cut control. This probe is data-only after one prepared model pass; no audio model inference is repeated for threshold variants.
selection: Compare automatic observed segment speaker count and complete segment assignments on both calibration cases. Stop before any held-out case unless one threshold satisfies both calibration count checks and changes the collapsed output; do not use count hints or tune against held-out data.
stopRule: A threshold that is unchanged across all retained segment assignments cannot explain the observed collapse. The probe must be recorded as refused; no provider or production threshold is promoted.
